title: angelica brevicaulis
intro: Angelica brevicaulis, commonly known as Korean angelica or dong quai, is a plant species native to East Asia. It is a perennial plant used in traditional medicine to promote women's health, with reported health benefits including menstrual relief, improved fertility, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Angelica brevicaulis are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, regulate blood flow, and reduce menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
